GSTIN 33AAACG2998N1Z5 and CIN U02429TZ1979PTC009946 are printed on the customs records themselves, confirming an active Tamil Nadu GST registration, but no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, domestic contract or annual-report India-sales split could be opened: tofler.in, zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com all returned HTTP 403, globalcalcium.com returned a bot-verification interstitial, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the whole session. Domestic turnover: null — not public in the sources reachable.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated Indian customs shipping-bill records with destination, HS code and B/L number, latest 2026-02-28, across Russia, Turkey, Canada, Poland and Taiwan — the company is an actual exporter of calcium/magnesium salts (gluconate, lactate, glubionate, saccharate). HS codes observed are 29181190 / 29181690 / 29181990 / 29181610, i.e. organic acid salts, not the declared 130219 (vegetable saps and extracts) — the declared HS 130219 is not supported by any shipment row seen; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, the code should be corrected to the factual 2918 family (verdict accepted_hs_corrected). The company also imports raw material (calcium gluconate from Shandong Xinhong, China), consistent with a manufacturer profile rather than a pure trader. Domestic supply: traces not found in the sources reachable — this is a gap in verification, not evidence of absence, since the company clearly holds an active GST registration and ships from Indian ports; turnover and domestic split left null rather than estimated. Source counters vs rows seen: 2739 claimed vs 5 visible on the India page; 5 claimed vs 5 visible on the US page.
